description: Hand-labeled acceptance cases for a small installed HeyTim bot set. These are development cases, not independent evidence of production accuracy.

bots.name: Trip Planner
bots.description: Plans vacations and travel: destinations, itineraries, flights, hotels, packing and accessibility.

bots.name: Budget Planner
bots.description: Builds household or group budgets, calculates expenses and fair cost splits, compares financial scenarios.

bots.name: Research & Reports
bots.description: Finds reliable factual answers, researches technical and scientific questions, compares evidence and writes reports.

bots.name: Mac Operator
bots.description: Operates websites and authorized Mac apps: opens apps, navigates screens, edits visible forms and verifies actions.

bots.name: Meme Lord
bots.description: Creates funny memes from image templates or user-supplied images and caption text.

cases.text: Plan a three-day vacation itinerary for Boston with two adults and a toddler. We need museums, stroller-friendly routes and a hotel near public transport.
Make a simple packing checklist for a weekend beach vacation.
Compare a trip to Tokyo versus Seoul for our family vacation, balancing flight time, vegetarian food, wheelchair accessibility and a total budget of six thousand dollars.
Split a restaurant bill of ninety dollars equally between three people. What does each person owe?
Build a monthly household budget from these numbers: income 5000, rent 1800, food 600, utilities 200, transport 300. Compare saving twenty versus thirty percent and explain the tradeoffs.
Add our expenses: groceries forty dollars and transport ten dollars. Give only the total.
What is the chemical symbol for gold?
Research the main differences between heat pumps and gas boilers and compare efficiency, cost assumptions and suitability for cold weather.

Conduct a deep technical research investigation into replacing a distributed database consensus protocol. Compare Raft, Multi-Paxos and Byzantine fault tolerance; prove safety under network partitions, examine interacting failure modes, and synthesize several competing architectures into a detailed recommendation.
Find the current population of Canada and give one official source.
Open the Calculator app on my Mac.
Navigate the open website, find the account settings screen and change the visible display name to Tim. Verify the saved result.
Make a funny distracted boyfriend meme with the caption me ignoring chores for another coding project.
Use my supplied cat image to make a meme saying when the meeting could have been an email.
Can you help me with that thing we discussed?
Coach me through a ten-minute breathing exercise.
